min_drop_percent.title: Smallest price drop (percent)
min_drop_percent.description: Against the price the customer saw when saving the item (or the last price they were told about).

cooldown_hours.title: Quiet time per saved item after a signal (hours)

in_stock_threshold.title: Units that count as in stock

locations.title: Stock locations that count
locations.description: Location ids of inventory.changed@1 to use; empty = every event (location or not).

accept_customer_events.title: Trust price and stock events from browsers
accept_customer_events.description: Off: only events from the merchant's servers (sk_ keys, merchant/staff/system actors) or Catalog count.

include_email.title: Include the customer's e-mail in published events
include_email.description: Off: events carry only the customer's subject (login id); on: also the e-mail from their login token, so a messaging product can reach them.
